PropFinder turns the prop market into a research lab. Built for MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, WNBA, and NCAA bettors who want to know why a line is off — not just hear someone say it is.

 - A free preview so you can test the app before you even purchase

START FOR FREE
No card. No trial countdown. Open the app and start digging. Upgrade only when you've decided we're worth it.

Type a player. Filter by matchup, line, book, or trend. Sort by edge. Whatever question you have about a prop, PropFinder has a screen for it.

CHEATSHEETS THAT RESPECT YOUR TIME
Don't have an hour to grind before lock? Our cheatsheets do the heavy lifting for you.

ODDS, ALL IN ONE PLACE

SAVE PROPS. SEND THEM STRAIGHT TO YOUR BOOK.

Done researching? You can export straights or parlays directly to your favorite sports books. 

BUILT FOR BASEBALL
MLB is where PropFinder started, and it shows. Pitch-level exit velocity filters. Park factors. Weather. Pitcher vs. lineup splits. Tools you won't find bundled anywhere else.

PREMIUM ACCESS
Research props free. Optional Premium access unlocks the full PropFinder toolkit across supported leagues, including MLB, NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, and NCAA.

om FanGraphs and MLB’s Baseball Savant and repackage it into color-coded charts. That’s it. Everything in here is already free on those sites, presented by the actual sources so you know the information is correct, unlike the info in PropFinder. There’s nothing original. It’s not the worst app I’ve seen, but there’s no reason to pay for it when the free data already exists in other places. I won’t be using it again. ionIndex":0}},"contentType":"productDescription","marker":null,"items":[{"$kind":"ProductDescription","paragraph":{"$kind":"Paragraph","text":"PROPFINDER — PLAYER PROP RESEARCH MADE EASY
 
PropFinder turns the prop market into a research lab. Built for MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, WNBA, and NCAA bettors who want to know why a line is off — not just hear someone say it is.

Here's what's inside:
 - A free preview so you can test the app before you even purchase
 - Thousands of pre-game props ranked by value
 - Cheatsheets that summarize the slate in seconds
 - Side-by-side odds from every major sportsbook and DFS PickEm site
 - Player history charts, gamelogs, and streak tracking
 - MLB-specific tools: HR Cheatsheet, Statcast exit velocity, ballpark + weather data
 - Daily injury feeds
 - A clean way to save props and send them straight to your sportsbook
 - Visualizations that actually mean something

Casual fan or full-time grinder, PropFinder is built so the answers come to you — not the other way around.

START FOR FREE
No card. No trial countdown. Open the app and start digging. Upgrade only when you've decided we're worth it.

SEARCH LIKE AN ANALYST
Type a player. Filter by matchup, line, book, or trend. Sort by edge. Whatever question you have about a prop, PropFinder has a screen for it.

CHEATSHEETS THAT RESPECT YOUR TIME
Don't have an hour to grind before lock? Our cheatsheets do the heavy lifting for you.

Every cheatsheet pulls every piece of research you'd normally chase across five different tabs — recent form, hit rates over the last 5, 10, and 20 games, matchup splits, opponent rank, home/away breakdowns, line movement, and the best available odds — and stacks it all into one scrollable screen. Sort by any column. Filter to the props you care about. Color coding makes the standouts impossible to miss.

It's the entire slate, distilled. MLB, NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, and NCAA — refreshed daily, ready when you open the app.

STATS YOU CAN ACTUALLY READ
A spreadsheet doesn't help if you can't see the story. PropFinder draws it. Recent form, matchup splits, hit rates, home/away breakdowns — all visual, all instant, all on one screen.

ODDS, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Every book. Every line. One view. Stop flipping between apps to chase a half-point — we surface the best number the moment it appears.

SAVE PROPS. SEND THEM STRAIGHT TO YOUR BOOK.
See a prop you like? Tap to save it. Your saved props build a personal shortlist as you research, so nothing gets lost in the shuffle.

Done researching? You can export straights or parlays directly to your favorite sports books. 

BUILT FOR BASEBALL
MLB is where PropFinder started, and it shows. Pitch-level exit velocity filters. Park factors. Weather. Pitcher vs. lineup splits. Tools you won't find bundled anywhere else.

PREMIUM ACCESS
Research props free. Optional Premium access unlocks the full PropFinder toolkit across supported leagues, including MLB, NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, and NCAA.

Premium availability, features, and plan details are shown in PropFinder when you choose to upgrade.

Terms and privacy:
https://www.propfinder.app/terms
https://www.propfinder.app/privacy

DISCLOSURE
All information and gambling related content is for informational and entertainment purposes only and is not gambling or financial advice. PropFinder is not a sportsbook and does not accept wagers or real-money deposits.

RESPONSIBLE GAMBLING
For adult users, for entertainment only. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

WHO BUILDS PROPFINDER?
Engineers, modelers, and bettors. We got tired of bouncing between tabs and spreadsheets to research a single prop, so we built the app we wished existed. Every feature ships because one of us needed it on a real slate.

DOWNLOAD PROPFINDER

title: propfinder-appstore.txt — part 25/47
body:
sMadness is the most comprehensive player prop research tool for NBA, MLB, WNBA, NFL and FIFA World Cup.

A player prop is a bet on an individual player's performance: points, assists, passing yards, rushing yards, and more. Props Madness gives you the data to research any prop in seconds, so you can make informed decisions instead of relying on gut feeling.

RESEARCH ANY PROP IN SECONDS
Select any player, any market, and instantly see season averages, hit rates, head-to-head history, similar player performance, and expected minutes. Every data point you need, on one screen, with no digging.

GO BEYOND THE BOX SCORE
Dive deep into how players produce their stats. Not just what they scored, but how and where.

For basketball: shooting zone breakdowns showing where players score, shot type analysis (catch & shoot, pull-up, isolation, pick & roll, post up), and player-vs-opponent defense comparisons that reveal mismatches the box score hides.

For football: passing, rushing, and receiving splits, red zone usage, target share, and matchup context against opponent pass and run defense rankings.

50+ FILTERS. ZERO BLIND SPOTS.
No other prop research tool gives you this level of filtering:

• Opponent defensive rankings by play type and shooting zone
• Position-based matchup rankings
• Pace, defensive rating, and situational stats
• Minutes, usage, snap count filters
• Closing line data
• Teammate on/off filters (played with / without)
• L5, L10, L15 and full season opponent defensive rankings

Every filter chip shows the opponent's actual ranking number. You can see at a glance whether a matchup is top-5 favorable or bottom-5 unfavorable without clicking into anything.

PERFORMANCE GRAPHS & TRENDS

SIMILAR PLAYERS ANALYSIS
See how statistically similar players have performed against the same opponent. A unique angle that adds context beyond a single player's history.

THREE SEASONS OF DATA. UPDATED DAILY.
Props Madness covers every active player across NBA, MLB, WNBA, and NFL with up to three seasons of historical data. Stats are updated daily so your research reflects the latest games. More sports coming soon.

Props Madness offers a free tier with limited access. For full access to all features, filters, and data, upgrade to Pro with monthly or yearly subscription.

Pick any player. In about thirty seconds you can see a projected number for their line, how often they have gone over/under, how they do against tonight's opponent, and which sportsbook has the best price on it. No paying someone else for their picks. No jumping between five tabs. You do the research, you make the call.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See a projected number for props across the full board
- Compare the same line across major sportsbooks in one tap
- Check how often a player has gone over or under, across recent games, the full season, or against this opponent
- Filter for the situations that actually matter, like home or away, rested or on a back to back, with or without a teammate in the lineup
- Work through a parlay one leg at a time with the same information behind every leg

PROJECTIONS
Every prop gets a projected number and a clear read on how that number lines up with the sportsbook price. You can see at a glance where the two disagree, then decide for yourself whether it is worth a bet.

THE MATCHUP MATRIX
A player's numbers change depending on who he is lined up against, and season averages hide that. The matchup matrix shows you how a player has actually performed against the specific opponent in front of him, so you are looking at tonight's matchup instead of an average built from forty other games. Season stats tell you who a player is - this tells you what the next matchup looks like. Containing advanced stats you won't find anywhere else, this is the heavy duty tool for serious research.

ODDS COMPARISON
Every book prices props differently, and most prices aren't worth taking. The app lines them up side by side and marks the ones that are, so you can see which book has odds worth your money and avoid the rest.

PLAYER RESEARCH LAB
Want to know how a player does when the starting player is injured? Or at home on three days of rest? Set the filters and you have the answer in seconds. This is the kind of thing that moves a line, and it usually takes forever to dig up by hand.

INSIGHTS
Everything you need to size up a prop in one view. Home and away splits, recent form, matchup history, and how the player performs with and without certain teammates. No piecing it together across five sites.

TRENDS AND HIT RATES
See which players have been hitting their lines and which runs are built on thin ground. Clear markers for recent games, the full season, and head to head history.

LEAGUE COVERAGE
NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, NCAA Football/Basketball. Something is always in season.

WHY I BUILT IT
Every feature in here exists because a user asked for it. When people said they felt buried in data, I made the important stats easier to analyze. When they said they were bouncing between five sites, I brought all the features into one app. The goal has never been to tell you what to bet, but to hand you the information and let you decide while making the research process easier. 

SUBSCRIPTION
Toad Sports is a monthly subscription app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

All content in this app is for informational and entertainment purposes only. WHY PROPSBOT.AI?

AI Confidence Score
Every prop is graded with a 0-100 score designed to show how strongly the model likes a play.

Edge Score
Find potential positive expected value by comparing PropsBot projections against sportsbook lines.

Confidence Gap
See where our model identifies a possible advantage compared to the market.

Alt Line Ladder Tool
Explore alternate lines, milestone props, payout paths, and ladder opportunities in one place. Compare risk, reward, and probability across multiple lines.

Line Movement & Closing Line Value
Track how lines move and see whether a pick is moving with or against the market.

Odds Comparison
Compare prices across major sportsbooks so you can find the best available number.

Trends, Hit Rates & Player Research
Review recent performance, rolling averages, matchup context, historical hit rates, and advanced stat signals.

Compare Tool
Stack players side by side to see who has the stronger statistical profile.

My Bets Tracker
Save picks, organize research, and monitor performance over time.


AUDITED AI PROP RESEARCH

PropsBot’s Confidence Score powers a public pick log of 218,000+ graded picks. Every pick is timestamped before grade time and tracked publicly at propsbot.ai/track-record/.

Our MLB probability calls have outperformed the Vegas closing line on Brier score accuracy: PropsBot MLB Brier 0.1903 vs. closing line Brier 0.1947. Lower is better.

See a bet you like - in a group chat, on X, in a screenshot from a buddy? Send it to Gambly. It reads the image, figures out the legs, and builds a betslip you can load straight into your sportsbook. No retyping, no hunting for the market, no rebuilding someone else's parlay by hand.

Don't have a bet in mind yet? Just ask.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Screenshot to betslip
Share a screenshot from anywhere. Gambly reads it, identifies the legs, and builds the slip for you to review.

Ask for anything
Props, parlays, same game parlays, first-basket markets, NRFI, alt lines, ladders - ask in plain English and Gambly finds it.

Browse the feed
Scroll trending slips, popular parlays, and what other bettors are loading right now. Filter by sport, player, or bet type.

Shop the line
Compare live odds across supported sportsbooks so you can see where a bet is available before you place it.

One tap to your book
Pick your sportsbook and jump straight to the bet, ready to load. Gambly works alongside the books you already use.

WHY GAMBLY

Gambly isn't a sportsbook and it isn't a picks service. We don't take your action and we don't sell you locks. We're the layer that makes finding a bet and acting on it fast - whether it came from a creator you follow, your group chat, or your own gut.

The more you use it, the better it gets at surfacing the bets you actually care about.

Free to use. Just bring your own sportsbook.

A player prop is a bet on an individual player's performance: points, assists, passing yards, rushing yards, and more. Props Madness gives you the data to research any prop in seconds, so you can make informed decisions instead of relying on gut feeling.

RESEARCH ANY PROP IN SECONDS
Select any player, any market, and instantly see season averages, hit rates, head-to-head history, similar player performance, and expected minutes. Every data point you need, on one screen, with no digging.

GO BEYOND THE BOX SCORE
Dive deep into how players produce their stats. Not just what they scored, but how and where.

For basketball: shooting zone breakdowns showing where players score, shot type analysis (catch & shoot, pull-up, isolation, pick & roll, post up), and player-vs-opponent defense comparisons that reveal mismatches the box score hides.

For football: passing, rushing, and receiving splits, red zone usage, target share, and matchup context against opponent pass and run defense rankings.

50+ FILTERS. ZERO BLIND SPOTS.
No other prop research tool gives you this level of filtering:

• Opponent defensive rankings by play type and shooting zone
• Position-based matchup rankings
• Pace, defensive rating, and situational stats
• Minutes, usage, snap count filters
• Closing line data
• Teammate on/off filters (played with / without)
• L5, L10, L15 and full season opponent defensive rankings

Every filter chip shows the opponent's actual ranking number. You can see at a glance whether a matchup is top-5 favorable or bottom-5 unfavorable without clicking into anything.

PERFORMANCE GRAPHS & TRENDS
Visualize player performance over time with interactive graphs. Toggle between averages and medians. Overlay advanced stats to spot trends and correlations that tables can't show you.

SIMILAR PLAYERS ANALYSIS
See how statistically similar players have performed against the same opponent. A unique angle that adds context beyond a single player's history.

THREE SEASONS OF DATA. UPDATED DAILY.
Props Madness covers every active player across NBA, MLB, WNBA, and NFL with up to three seasons of historical data. Stats are updated daily so your research reflects the latest games. More sports coming soon.

SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Props Madness offers a free tier with limited access. For full access to all features, filters, and data, upgrade to Pro with monthly or yearly subscription.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Account Settings.

RESPONSIBLE GAMBLING
If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, please seek professional help. Visit http://www.begambleaware.org for support and resources.

Props Madness is not affiliated with or endorsed by the NBA, MLB, WNBA, NFL, or any other sports league or sportsbook. It is not a gambling site and does not accept or place wagers of any kind.

Pick any player. In about thirty seconds you can see a projected number for their line, how often they have gone over/under, how they do against tonight's opponent, and which sportsbook has the best price on it. No paying someone else for their picks. No jumping between five tabs. You do the research, you make the call.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See a projected number for props across the full board
- Compare the same line across major sportsbooks in one tap
- Check how often a player has gone over or under, across recent games, the full season, or against this opponent
- Filter for the situations that actually matter, like home or away, rested or on a back to back, with or without a teammate in the lineup
- Work through a parlay one leg at a time with the same information behind every leg

PROJECTIONS
Every prop gets a projected number and a clear read on how that number lines up with the sportsbook price. You can see at a glance where the two disagree, then decide for yourself whether it is worth a bet.

THE MATCHUP MATRIX
A player's numbers change depending on who he is lined up against, and season averages hide that. The matchup matrix shows you how a player has actually performed against the specific opponent in front of him, so you are looking at tonight's matchup instead of an average built from forty other games. Season stats tell you who a player is - this tells you what the next matchup looks like. Containing advanced stats you won't find anywhere else, this is the heavy duty tool for serious research.

ODDS COMPARISON
Every book prices props differently, and most prices aren't worth taking. The app lines them up side by side and marks the ones that are, so you can see which book has odds worth your money and avoid the rest.

PLAYER RESEARCH LAB
Want to know how a player does when the starting player is injured? Or at home on three days of rest? Set the filters and you have the answer in seconds. This is the kind of thing that moves a line, and it usually takes forever to dig up by hand.

INSIGHTS
Everything you need to size up a prop in one view. Home and away splits, recent form, matchup history, and how the player performs with and without certain teammates. No piecing it together across five sites.

TRENDS AND HIT RATES
See which players have been hitting their lines and which runs are built on thin ground. Clear markers for recent games, the full season, and head to head history.

LEAGUE COVERAGE
NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, NCAA Football/Basketball. Something is always in season.

WHY I BUILT IT
Every feature in here exists because a user asked for it. When people said they felt buried in data, I made the important stats easier to analyze. When they said they were bouncing between five sites, I brought all the features into one app. The goal has never been to tell you what to bet, but to hand you the information and let you decide while making the research process easier. 

SUBSCRIPTION
Toad Sports is a monthly subscription app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

DISCLOSURE
All content in this app is for informational and entertainment purposes only. It is not gambling advice or financial advice, and nothing here is a prediction of an outcome or a guarantee of any result. Toad Sports is not a sportsbook. It does not accept wagers or real money deposits. You must be of legal age to bet in your area. If gambling is causing a problem for you, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

WHY PROPSBOT.AI?

AI Confidence Score
Every prop is graded with a 0-100 score designed to show how strongly the model likes a play.

Edge Score
Find potential positive expected value by comparing PropsBot projections against sportsbook lines.

Confidence Gap
See where our model identifies a possible advantage compared to the market.

Alt Line Ladder Tool
Explore alternate lines, milestone props, payout paths, and ladder opportunities in one place. Compare risk, reward, and probability across multiple lines.

Line Movement & Closing Line Value
Track how lines move and see whether a pick is moving with or against the market.

Odds Comparison
Compare prices across major sportsbooks so you can find the best available number.

Trends, Hit Rates & Player Research
Review recent performance, rolling averages, matchup context, historical hit rates, and advanced stat signals.

Compare Tool
Stack players side by side to see who has the stronger statistical profile.

My Bets Tracker
Save picks, organize research, and monitor performance over time.


AUDITED AI PROP RESEARCH

PropsBot’s Confidence Score powers a public pick log of 218,000+ graded picks. Every pick is timestamped before grade time and tracked publicly at propsbot.ai/track-record/.

Our MLB probability calls have outperformed the Vegas closing line on Brier score accuracy: PropsBot MLB Brier 0.1903 vs. closing line Brier 0.1947. Lower is better.

See a bet you like - in a group chat, on X, in a screenshot from a buddy? Send it to Gambly. It reads the image, figures out the legs, and builds a betslip you can load straight into your sportsbook. No retyping, no hunting for the market, no rebuilding someone else's parlay by hand.

Don't have a bet in mind yet? Just ask.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Screenshot to betslip
Share a screenshot from anywhere. Gambly reads it, identifies the legs, and builds the slip for you to review.

Ask for anything
Props, parlays, same game parlays, first-basket markets, NRFI, alt lines, ladders - ask in plain English and Gambly finds it.

Browse the feed
Scroll trending slips, popular parlays, and what other bettors are loading right now. Filter by sport, player, or bet type.

Shop the line
Compare live odds across supported sportsbooks so you can see where a bet is available before you place it.

One tap to your book
Pick your sportsbook and jump straight to the bet, ready to load. Gambly works alongside the books you already use.

WHY GAMBLY

Gambly isn't a sportsbook and it isn't a picks service. We don't take your action and we don't sell you locks. We're the layer that makes finding a bet and acting on it fast - whether it came from a creator you follow, your group chat, or your own gut.

The more you use it, the better it gets at surfacing the bets you actually care about.

Free to use. Just bring your own sportsbook.

e stats, context, and signals in one place

Key features that you’ll have access to with your React Live subscription include:

- League-wide live game feed: Follow momentum swings, scoring runs, and key moments across all live games in real time.
- Game flow and market context: View game progression alongside market movement to understand when perception and reality begin to diverge.
- Performance vs baseline analysis: Compare live performance to a team’s typical results to judge whether trends are likely to hold or regress.
- Lineup and rotation intelligence: Track who’s on the floor, how lineup combinations are performing together, and how rotation changes impact the game.
- All-in-one live view: Monitor stats, market movement, and key game context for multiple live games on one screen.

You’ll also have access to live support if you ever have questions or need guidance on using the product.

We regularly release new features and improvements. Have ideas for something you’d like to see? Send us a note!

ABOUT US
The team behind React Live is a small group of sports fans and engineers. Our mission is to create smarter, more confident and more enjoyable betting experiences. We don’t earn revenue from sports books or affiliates, only from constantly satisfied customers.

DISCLOSURE

All information and gambling related content is for informational and entertainment purposes only and is not gambling or financial advice. React Live is not a sportsbook and does not accept wagers or real-money deposits.

*React Live is a subscription service that costs $39.99/month or $289.99/year. An early-bird offering costs $9.99/month or $59.99/year. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renews at the same price unless disabled in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Features

Proprietary data:

  • DTN FastRacks — provides fuel rack prices from more than 1,900 U.S. and Canadian terminals
  • DTN ProphetX Platinum Weather – leverage historical and daily forecasts including Weighted Degree Day data for 200+ locations across the U.S.
  • DTN Temperature Correction Index – the best source for true terminal product temperature insights at the rack
  • Refined Fuel Demand — daily aggregated, anonymized, and filtered data, available at a rack city or PADD level

Mobile access:

  • Get anytime, anywhere access to the critical market information you need

Excel Add-in:

  • Export and upload data into your proprietary models using the industry’s leading tool

Top-notch customer service:

  • Get knowledgeable, courteous support from our team of experts, Monday-Friday, from 12 a.m. to 6 p.m. CT

Benefits

Data flexibility:

  • Easily export valuable data through DTN ProphetX’s powerful Excel Add-in tool
  • Quickly integrate mid and back-office data throughout your organization using a variety of methods, such as FTP & API
  • Compatible with all of the major E/CTRM solutions — supporting market and proprietary data integration
  • Better anticipate energy demands with highly customizable weighted degree day data
  • Be confident in your positions by making fact-based decisions founded on accurate market and volume insights

Cost-effectiveness:

  • Historical and forecast weather data is included
  • Get the level of access you need at the right cost for your budget
  • When cost is a concern, DTN ProphetX provides the industry’s best analytics and value — without sacrificing LIVE, professional customer service

Single-platform ease:

  • Easily access data from a wide variety of sources using a single solution — saving you time and allowing you to quickly leverage valuable insights
  • Avoid the delays and lack of reliability that often come from using disparate systems
  • Be able to quickly identify and make better trades — supporting greater profits

Workflow
How it works
How a pro turns the tools above into an actual bet, on two real MLB markets.

Transcript summary

In this walkthrough, Pips, a professional sports bettor, runs through his full PropsMadness research process for two MLB markets: home runs and strikeouts. He opens by checking his tracked results on an outside tracker, where his home run bets have run at a 7% ROI over the past two months.
For home runs, he starts on the slate-wide home run environment reading for each game and skips anything strongly negative, favoring matchups closer to neutral or positive. From there he checks the opposing starter's home run and barrel rate allowed, looking for pitchers trending worse lately even if their season numbers look average.
His featured example is a hitter facing a struggling starter with weak home run prevention. Breaking the pitcher's arsenal down by pitch type shows the batter grades in the 90th-plus percentile against exactly the two pitches that starter throws most, while the pitcher barely throws the one pitch the batter handles worst.
He layers on more context: the hitter's plate appearances per game have climbed as he's moved up the batting order, his rolling home-run rate is far outpacing his season average, and in games with a similar park/weather environment to this one he's already homered in 10 of his last 16. He closes the pick by comparing odds across books to find the best price before betting.
Switching to strikeouts, his first example is a starter pitching in a favorable park who faces a lineup that's strong against right-handed pitching overall but ranks near the bottom against left-handers specifically. Filtering the pitcher's own game log to only the match ranked opponents shows his strikeout rate collapsing well under the posted line in that split.
A second strikeout example uses a full three-season sample for a different starter: filtered down to games against bottom-tier strikeout matchups, he clears the line in the large majority of starts, while the same filter against tougher lineups shows the exact opposite. The takeaway he leaves viewers with: the matchup-specific filtering is what turns a season average into an actual edge.

Polymarket wallet trackerResearch public wallets and whale activity.Payout calculatorEstimate Kalshi and Polymarket payout, EV, and risk.Copy trading toolsCompare bots, wallet following, and safer research.AI for KalshiBuild an evidence-first AI forecasting workflow.

What Alphascope does for prediction market traders

Alphascope is a research workspace for people who follow Polymarket, Kalshi, and other prediction markets. The product brings live odds, AI forecasts, news impact analysis, and market pages into one crawlable workflow. Instead of opening several dashboards, scanning social feeds, and manually checking whether a headline matches the contract, users can start from a market, a category, or a plain-English question and move toward the evidence behind the price.

Prediction market prices are useful because they compress many opinions into one number, but the number alone is not enough. A Yes price can be high because the event is likely, because liquidity is thin, because traders are reacting to a headline, or because another related contract moved first. Alphascope helps separate those cases by pairing the price with context.

The Alphascope research workflow

A typical workflow starts on the live odds board. Users scan active categories such as elections, economy, sports, and crypto, then open a specific market page. The market page shows the current implied probability, the platform, and the AI forecast context. From there, users can review market-moving news, compare related contracts, and decide whether the current price still leaves enough edge after fees, spread, and settlement risk.

Another workflow starts from news. If a headline appears to move a set of markets, users can open the affected contracts and compare the move with the resolution criteria. This is useful when traders are not sure whether a story is a real catalyst or only a temporary sentiment shock. The strongest setup is a story that directly affects settlement and has not yet been fully reflected in the live price.

Why AI forecasts need live market context

A model forecast can be directionally useful and still be a poor trade if the market price is already better informed. That is why Alphascope keeps forecasts near live odds rather than presenting AI predictions as standalone picks. The value comes from the gap between the model's reasoning and the market's current consensus. When that gap is large, the next step is to understand why. When the gap is small, the market may already be efficient.

Live context also helps avoid false confidence. If a forecast points to a 60 percent outcome and the market is 58 percent, the difference may not justify risk. If the market is 40 percent, the gap may deserve deeper review, but only after checking liquidity and settlement. By keeping those checks together, Alphascope makes the decision more disciplined.

Markets and categories Alphascope covers

Election markets often depend on polls, fundraising, candidate news, legal decisions, turnout signals, and party-control dynamics. Economy markets depend on data releases, Federal Reserve communication, inflation prints, jobs reports, and revisions. Sports markets depend on injuries, lineups, scheduling, weather, and in-game volatility. Crypto markets depend on spot prices, exchange news, ETF flows, regulation, and sudden liquidity changes.

Each category needs a different research rhythm, but the core process is the same: read the question, check the price, inspect the catalyst, compare related markets, and size risk only if the edge survives execution costs. Alphascope is built to make that process faster without hiding the uncertainty that makes prediction markets interesting.

Where to go next

Start with live prediction market odds if you want to scan the board, AI predictions if you want markets ranked with forecast context, news impact if a catalyst is moving prices, or the forecast composer if you already have a specific link or question. Each path leads back to the same research loop, so users can move from broad discovery to specific market analysis without losing context.

The goal is a cleaner prediction market workflow: fewer stale prices missed, fewer headlines traded without contract context, and fewer assumptions about whether Polymarket and Kalshi are asking the exact same question. That is the practical reason for combining odds, news, AI forecast

s, and internally linked market pages in one place.

Why crawlable market context matters

Many prediction market products hide useful context inside private dashboards, client-only state, or short cards that are hard for search engines to interpret. Alphascope keeps important market context in crawlable pages so users can find the same research path from search, social links, or direct navigation. That includes the market title, category, platform, current probability, related research links, and plain-language explanation of how the odds should be read.

Crawlable context also helps users revisit a market later. A prediction market can change quickly, and a transient app state is easy to lose. A stable page lets users compare today's price with the next news cycle, share a contract with another researcher, and move between topic pages without starting the workflow over.

How traders can combine categories

The strongest research often crosses categories. A political event can affect regulatory markets, crypto markets, and economy markets. A macro data release can affect Fed odds, equities, crypto, and recession contracts. A sports injury can affect game winner contracts, player props, and championship odds. Alphascope groups categories separately for scanning, but the research workflow is designed to move across categories when a catalyst has broader impact.

This is where related market review matters. If one market moves and a nearby market does not, the difference may be a lead-lag opportunity. If every related market moves at once, the board may already understand the catalyst. If the markets move in conflicting directions, the first task is to check whether the questions are actually equivalent. The homepage links into each of those research paths.

A simple checklist before acting on a market

Before acting on any market, write down the live probability, your estimate, the strongest evidence for your estimate, the strongest evidence against it, the settlement source, and the maximum amount you are willing to lose. Then check the spread and liquidity. If the position only looks attractive before execution costs, the edge is probably not strong enough. If the contract language is ambiguous, reduce size or skip the trade.

Alphascope is designed to support that checklist without turning it into busywork. The odds board gives the price, the forecast gives structured reasoning, the news page gives catalysts, and the tool pages help with probability and payout math. The trader still makes the decision, but the information is organized so fewer important checks are missed.

How Alphascope differs from a static market list

A static market list tells you what is available. Alphascope is designed to show what deserves research next. The difference is the connection between pages: a live market can lead to a forecast, a forecast can lead to news, a news item can lead back to related markets, and a calculator can turn the final price into payout and risk. That creates a loop users can repeat whenever a new catalyst appears.

This structure also keeps the homepage useful for visitors who do not already know which market they want. They can start with the product overview, move into odds or forecasts, and learn how the pieces fit together before committing to a specific contract. That makes the page more informative than a hero section plus a few market cards.

Research habits Alphascope is built to reinforce

The first habit is writing down a probability before looking for confirmation. The second is checking whether the market's settlement rule matches the story being discussed. The third is comparing a market with nearby contracts instead of treating it as isolated. The fourth is measuring payout and downside before increasing size. The fifth is being willing to skip a market when the edge depends on a weak source or a wide spread.

Alphascope cannot make those decisions for the user, and it should not try to. Its job is to organize the information so the habits are easier to follow. A trader who consistently checks price, rules, liquidity, news, related markets, and payout will avoid many of the mistakes that come from trading only the most exciting headline.

How to move from discovery to a decision

Discovery starts with finding markets that are active enough to deserve attention. Decision making starts only after the market has passed a stricter filter: clear settlement language, a price that differs from your estimate, enough liquidity to enter, and a catalyst that can be verified from a reliable source. Alphascope is built to separate those two phases so users do not confuse an interesting market with an actionable one.

That distinction matters on every visit. Some users arrive to scan broad categories, some arrive from a news headline, and some arrive with a specific Polymarket or Kalshi link. Each path should end in the same disciplined question: does this contract still offer value at the current price after spread, fees, liquidity, correlation, and settlement risk? If the answer is unclear, the next step is more research, not a larger position.

Why fewer stronger signals beat a noisy feed

A noisy feed can make every price move feel urgent. A stronger research system filters for the few markets where the question, catalyst, liquidity, and forecast disagreement are all worth attention. Alphascope keeps the homepage focused on the main research paths so users can choose the right starting point instead of scrolling through every available contract at once.

Once a user needs breadth, the dedicated odds and predictions pages provide it. The homepage should introduce the workflow, show current market context, and point to deeper pages. That balance gives users enough live information to understand the product while keeping the page readable, crawlable, and focused on the next research step.

title: px_artemisanalytics_com_home.raw — part 12/22
body:
v class="border">
Valuable for Fundamental Research

Artemis has proven to be a valuable tool for my fundamental research. I find the Excel plug-in very useful because it allows me to pull in multiple data sources into Excel without having to go to each of these sources’ websites for the data. Generally, it’s one of the tools I use day-to-day, and I am impressed by the team and constant improvement of the platform.

David Alderman

Research Analyst at Franklin Templeton

Center of Daily Workflow

Artemis is the center of our daily workflow; we automate spreadsheets to track relevant metrics for verticals that we cover using the Artemis API; and also directly look at the Artemis dashboard to find out fundamental metrics across blockchains and specific categories such as perpetual exchanges and lending and borrowing market. I also like how the Artemis team has been responsive to feedback and comments from us; and the way they keep shipping new features from time to time - huge fan of Artemis and I would suggest Artemis to all liquid crypto investors out there!

Cody Poh

Investment Analyst at Pantera Capital

Integral to Investing

Artemis is integral to our investment process. We use Artemis Sheets on a daily basis for all our excel-based workflow, whether that involves updating fundamental metrics (TVL, volume, revenue) or prices. We use Artemis Dashboards to dive deeper into fundamental data across L1/L2 ecosystems, and category specific applications (perpetuals).Some of the more recent products like Blockchain Activity Monitor (BAM) help us identify new and upcoming protocols that are seeing an inflection in usage, and the latest Chart Builder allows us to easily visualize and compare protocols in an easy, no code way.We are huge fans of the Artemis product and team!

James Ho and Vincent Jow

Co-Founders of Modular Capital

Tool I use Most

Artemis is the tool I use the most. Go and look at my 50+ articles published in the last year. Artemis is the most widely sourced. Artemis is my go to for pulling on chain data and easily comparing metrics across protocols. I also use it to build dashboards and models in Excel and Google Sheets that update with a click of a button. Check out the Ethereum template I built on Artemis sample templates.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const videoItems = document.querySelectorAll(".video-item");
  const weeklyInfos = document.querySelectorAll(".weekly-info");
  const weeklyItems = document.querySelectorAll(".weekly-item");
  const weeklyLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".weekly-links");

  function showVideo(index, play = false) {
    // Show/hide videos
    videoItems.forEach((item, i) => {
      item.style.display = i === index ? "block" : "none";
    });
  
    // Update is-playing class
    weeklyItems.forEach((item, i) => {
      item.classList.toggle("is-playing", i === index);
    });
  
    // Show links only for current item
    weeklyLinks.forEach((links, i) => {
      links.style.display = i === index ? "flex" : "none";
    });
  
    // Play video if requested
    if (play) {
      const videoScreen = videoItems[index]?.querySelector(".video-screen");
      if (videoScreen && window.playYoutubeVideo) {
        window.playYoutubeVideo(videoScreen);
      }
    }
  }

  // Show first video on load
  showVideo(0);

  // Clicking weekly-info only switches video
  weeklyInfos.forEach((info, index) => {
    info.addEventListener("click", () => {
      // If this item isn't currently playing, stop the active video
      if (!weeklyItems[index].classList.contains("is-playing")) {
        window.stopYoutubeVideo?.();
      }
      showVideo(index);
    });
  });

  // Clicking play button switches, updates is-playing, and plays
  weeklyItems.forEach((item, index) => {
    const button = item.querySelector('[data-video-play="true"]');
    if (!button) return;

    button.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();

      showVideo(index, true);
    });
  });
});

<!-- Youtube Videos -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  let activeContainer = null;
  let activeVideoWrap = null;

  function getYouTubeId(url) {
    return url.match(
      /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/)|youtu\.be\/)([^?&/]+)/
    )?.[1];
  }

  function playVideo(videoScreen) {
    const container = videoScreen.querySelector(".youtube-video");
    const videoWrap = videoScreen.querySelector(".video-wrap");

    if (!container) return;

    // If already playing, do nothing
    if (activeContainer === container) return;

    // Stop previous video
    stopVideo();

    const videoId = getYouTubeId(videoScreen.dataset.youtubeUrl);
    if (!videoId) return;

    // Hide current thumbnail
    if (videoWrap) {
      videoWrap.style.display = "none";
    }

    // Load video
    container.innerHTML = `
      <iframe
        src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}?autoplay=1&rel=0&playsinline=1"
        style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;"
        frameborder="0"
        allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
        allowfullscreen>
      </iframe>
    `;

    activeContainer = container;
    activeVideoWrap = videoWrap;
  }

  function stopVideo() {
    // Remove active iframe
    if (activeContainer) {
      activeContainer.innerHTML = "";
    }

    // Restore thumbnail
    if (activeVideoWrap) {
      activeVideoWrap.style.display = "";
    }

    activeContainer = null;
    activeVideoWrap = null;
  }

  // Expose functions globally
  window.playYoutubeVideo = playVideo;
  window.stopYoutubeVideo = stopVideo;

  // Clicking the video itself plays it
  document.querySelectorAll(".video-screen").forEach(videoScreen => {
    videoScreen.addEventListener("click", () => {
      playVideo(videoScreen);
    });
  });

});
</script>

<script>
let swiperLoaded = false;

function loadSwiper() {
  if (!swiperLoaded) {
    swiperLoaded = true;

    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@8/swiper-bundle.min.js";
    script.onload = () => {
      console.log("Swiper loaded");
      initSwiper();
    };

    document.body.appendChild(script);
  }
}

function initSwiper() {

  $("#testimonials").each(function () {

    const wrapper = $(this).closest(".testimonial-slider");
    const current = wrapper.find("#currentCount");
    const total = wrapper.find("#totalCount");

    function updateCounter(swiper) {
      const pages = Math.ceil(swiper.slides.length / swiper.params.slidesPerGroup);
      const page = Math.floor(swiper.activeIndex / swiper.params.slidesPerGroup) + 1;

      total.text(pages);
      current.text(page);
    }

    new Swiper(this, {
      speed: 500,
      loop: false,
      autoHeight: false,
      centeredSlides: false,
      grabCursor: true,
      autoplay: false,

      // Mobile
      slidesPerView: 1,
      slidesPerGroup: 1,

      // Tablet & Desktop
      breakpoints: {
        768: {
          slidesPerView: 2,
          slidesPerGroup: 2,
        },
        992: {
          slidesPerView: 3,
          slidesPerGroup: 3,
        }
      },

      navigation: {
        nextEl: wrapper.find('[swiper-button="next"]')[0],
        prevEl: wrapper.find('[swiper-button="prev"]')[0],
        disabledClass: "is-disabled"
      },

      pagination: {
        el: wrapper.find(".swiper-pagination")[0],
        bulletActiveClass: "is-current",
        bulletClass: "swiper-bullet",
        bulletElement: "div",
        clickable: true
      },

      on: {
        init: function (swiper) {
          updateCounter(swiper);
        },
        slideChange: function (swiper) {
          updateCounter(swiper);
        },
        breakpoint: function (swiper) {
          updateCounter(swiper);
        }
      }
    });

  });

}

document.addEventListener("touchstart", loadSwiper, { once: true });
document.addEventListener("mousemove", loadSwiper, { once: true });

</script></body></html>

Keys, credits & usage

Create keys, top up credits, track usage per key, all self-serve.

Our thesis

Access stopped being the hard part.

Every team can call the same frontier models through an API. The waste moved somewhere else: choice. Modern apps fire millions of model calls, and most teams point every one at a single expensive model. They pay frontier prices to answer “hi,” and still gamble on quality where it counts.

DataLayer is infrastructure for cost-efficient intelligence. For each request we predict difficulty, rank models on a cost/quality curve, and choose how to reason: direct, plan-and-execute, orchestrate, or fuse. Easy work runs cheap; recurring work amortizes to a small-model price; hard work escalates to match or beat the frontier.

And because we meter every real cost, we show the one number nobody else will: how much you saved by not running everything on a premium model. Intelligence per dollar, measured, not promised.

Workloads at scale, with controls.

    Pick your contests

    The live lobby sits inside the Workspace: fill and rake on every contest straight from DraftKings and FanDuel, and overlay flagged when it's real — near lock.

  2. 2

    Shape the pool

    Projections, ownership, and matchup data on every player. Override anything; the engine builds against your numbers.

  3. 3

    Build & Sim

    One click. 10,000 simulations per contest against its real payout curve, on fields modeled from how entrants actually play it. Every night the engine grades its builds against real contests.

  4. 4

    Fill and go

    Your entry count is selected from the build. Fill your entries, export one upload-ready CSV, late swap after lock.

Also in the Workspace.

Hero Chat
Tell it the angle. It finds the contest, proposes the settings, and fires the build on your OK. Power plan.
Live data
Injuries, ownership, weather, and projections update all day. The big moves get pushed to your phone.
Stack IQ
Ranks the strongest correlated stacks on the slate before you build. NFL, NHL, MLB, and CFB classic slates.
Late swap
After lock, re-solves the unlocked slots in every entry with the locked players pinned. By hand, or on a cloud run.
Handbuild
Build one lineup at a time by hand, with the full data grid and the sim scores behind every pick.
Coverage
Reads the sims and selects the lineup set with the most independent paths to a win. The default after every sim.
Projection Hub
Upload your own numbers, blend the sources you trust, or build a custom scoring formula. It all writes to My Proj.
Lineup Filter
Slice the built pool by any metric, from ROI to ownership to salary, and keep only the lineups you want.
Contest Analyzer
Open any finished contest: ownership, the stacks that cashed, what the top entrants did, and the dupes.
See the full toolbelt

The game is played first. Every number comes from it.

Before lock, every game on the slate is played 10,000 times: at-bat by at-bat, possession by possession, drive by drive. For every player, the Hero Projection is the average of those games. The percentile outlook and the correlation heatmap come from the same games. And when you simulate a contest, those players are scored inside them, so a stack wins together or loses together, the way it does on game day.
